matched_question.prompt: Compare a Process and a Thread, and explain common Inter-Process Communication (IPC) mechanisms.

transcripts.raw_spoken: A process is a running program with its own memory space. So one process cannot directly change another process's data. A thread is a unit of execution instead of a process, and all threads in that process share the same heap memory.
